title: Sunny and the Lighthouse Glow
originalStory: A fluffy orange cat named Sunny lived in a cozy lighthouse by the sea, where she purred cheerfully next to the big glowing light every evening. One foggy night, when the lighthouse keeper accidentally fell asleep, Sunny noticed the light flickering. She nuzzled against the warm glass to keep it awake, and the ships in the distance saw the friendly glow guiding them safely through the mist.
visualBible:
Sunny: fluffy orange cat
Charlie: adult man, lighthouse keeper, wearing a blue sweater and cap

pages.text: Sunny the fluffy orange cat loved her cozy home in the lighthouse by the sea. Every evening, she purred happily beside the big glowing light. 'You keep the ships safe, don't you?' she meowed softly to the light.
pages.illustrationScene: Sunny is comfortably curled up on the wooden floor next to the large glowing light in the lighthouse. The scene is warm and peaceful, with the sea visible through a nearby window.

pages.text: One foggy night, the lighthouse keeper Charlie accidentally fell asleep in his chair. Sunny heard a soft flicker from the big light. She stretched and padded over curiously, her whiskers twitching.
pages.illustrationScene: Charlie is napping in a cozy armchair, his blue sweater contrasting with the warm glow of the light. Sunny is awake, sitting on the floor and looking curiously at the light.

pages.text: Sunny felt the light needed a friend, so she nuzzled against the warm glass, purring with all her might. 'I'll help you stay bright,' she promised with a gentle purr.
pages.illustrationScene: Sunny is gently nuzzling against the base of the big lighthouse light, her eyes half-closed with contentment. The room is softly lit, creating a feeling of warmth and safety.

pages.text: The ships out at sea saw the steady glow through the mist and sailed safely. When Charlie awoke, he smiled at Sunny. 'Thank you for helping,' he said, giving her a gentle pat.
pages.illustrationScene: Charlie, now awake, is smiling down at Sunny, who is sitting happily beside him. Through the window, a few distant ships are visible on the calm sea.
